events.verdict: Oubre Jr. (PHI) establishes himself in Mann's (CHA) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Mann (CHA) aligns his path to move alongside Maxey's (PHI) path to the basket, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Mann (CHA) steps forward into Maxey's (PHI) path and initiates contact with his leg/foot that affects his driving shot attempt.
Drummond (PHI) turns into Ball's (CHA) path and delivers body contact that affects Ball's SQBR at the end of the drive.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
Grimes (PHI) extends his forearm into Ball's (CHA) front during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) briefly grasps Bridges' (CHA) jersey as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Drummond (PHI) is already in Mann's (CHA) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Mann (CHA) is moving alongside Maxey's (PHI) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Mann (CHA) establishes himself in Maxey's (PHI) path and does not deliver contact.
Kalkbrenner (CHA) is already in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Knueppel (CHA) commits a take foul on Drummond (PHI).
Grimes (PHI) contests the jump shot attempt by Bridges (CHA) and the contact to his non-shooting hand is more than marginal.
Sexton (CHA) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
